title: I love the feel of these sheets.
text: I love the feel of these sheets.. These sheets feel nice and luxurious.  The reason for only 4 stars is because after only about 3 washings, it already has some pilling.  I'm very disappointed in that considering the price of these sheets.  I have only washed them in cold water and dried on medium heat.  $150 is a lot of money for sheets that pill that quickly.

product_metadata.title: Gryphon Home Luxury Suite Sheet Set, Queen, Sky Blue
features: If you're looking for softness and uncompromising elegance, Gryphon recommends Luxury Suite.
It offers the softness and durability of 100% cotton with an elegant, polished finish.
Luxury Suite is woven for a silky touch, and a rich weight that drapes beautifully on your bed.
Set includes 1 Fitted Sheet, 1 Flat Sheet, and 2 Pillowcases. Additional pillowcase pairs are sold separately.
